stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of Meta's Llama 3 8B model on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized under text-generation pipelines, indicating its primary function.
Key technologies associated include transformers and safetensors, standard in modern LLM deployment.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its application in large language model tasks.
The tags confirm its relevance within the transformers, llama, and safetensors ecosystems.

stories.title: Why China is giving away its best AI models
stories.author: Robert Hart
bullet_points: Chinese AI firm Moonshot AI has released Kimi K3, a new AI model.
Kimi K3 is reported to perform competitively against top US AI systems at a lower cost.
The release intensifies the ongoing technological rivalry between China and Silicon Valley in the AI sector.

stories.title: Amazon’s trying to launch a global satellite cellphone network in 2028
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: Amazon is developing a global satellite cellphone network using a new Leo constellation.
The service aims to provide direct-to-device connectivity for voice, messaging, data, and emergency services.
Deployment is targeted for 2028, pending FCC approval and partnerships with mobile network operators.

stories.title: Nvidia, Microsoft launch open AI security alliance — without OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic
stories.author: Robert Hart
bullet_points: Nvidia and Microsoft launched the Open Secure AI Alliance to develop and share open-source AI security tools.
The alliance includes major players like SpaceX and IBM, forming a coalition outside of OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic.
The initiative is a direct industry response to growing concerns regarding the safety and security risks posed by frontier AI models.

stories.title: Exploiting Volvo/Eicher's fleet platform to gain control over all users/vehicles
stories.author: EatonZ
bullet_points: A critical vulnerability was discovered in the fleet platform used by Volvo/Eicher.
The exploit allows an attacker to gain control over all users and vehicles connected to the platform.
This represents a severe security risk targeting connected vehicle infrastructure.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on the Hugging Face platform.
The model is categorized for text-generation tasks, indicating its primary function as a large language model (LLM).
It is associated with key ML technologies like transformers and safetensors, placing it within the current LLM ecosystem.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.31 achieves significant speed improvements for Gemma 4 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Speedup reaches up to 90% when Gemma 4 is utilized with coding agents, as validated by the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to updates in the MLX engine.
Improvements include faster response times, higher quality model output, and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra, a new AI model.
The model is specifically designed for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is optimized for supporting long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for building personal AI agents.
The key feature is that these agents can run entirely on the user's local hardware.
Integration with Ollama is built-in, facilitating the use of local Large Language Models (LLMs).

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for performance optimization.
This integration specifically targets Apple Silicon, promising faster local AI inference.
The feature is currently available in a preview build, indicating ongoing development and adoption.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed for local execution.
It integrates messaging apps with local AI coding agents.
The key feature is running all AI processes entirely on the user's own device for privacy.

stories.title: Big Tech accused of stonewalling European social media researchers
stories.author: Anna Desmarais, wired.com
bullet_points: Major social media platforms (TikTok, X, Meta) are facing accusations of non-compliance.
Researchers claim these Big Tech companies are withholding data they are legally obligated to provide.
The issue highlights ongoing tensions between tech giants and European regulatory/research bodies.

stories.title: CausalForge: A Formally Grounded, Self-Improving Agentic Framework for Automated Research in Causal Inference
stories.author: Vasilis Syrgkanis
bullet_points: Introduces CausalForge, a new agentic framework designed for automated theoretical research in causal inference.
Addresses the critical limitation of current LLM reviewers, which are often empirically unreliable in validating research.
Grounds the framework in the Lean proof methodology to ensure formal correctness and self-improvement in the research loop.

stories.title: CausalForge: A Formally Grounded, Self-Improving Agentic Framework for Automated Research in Causal Inference
stories.author: Vasilis Syrgkanis
bullet_points: Introduces CausalForge, a new agentic framework designed for automated theoretical research in causal inference.
Addresses the critical flaw in current LLM-based research loops: the empirical unreliability of LLM reviewers in validating scientific claims.
Grounds the framework in the Lean proof methodology to ensure formal correctness and self-improvement in the research process.

stories.title: Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills
stories.author: Guanjun Jiang
bullet_points: The paper addresses a core challenge in LLM self-evolution: balancing task diversity against reliable feedback.
Existing methods are limited, either being too narrow (environment-bound) or too unreliable (open-ended self-generation).
The proposed solution introduces 'agent skills' to facilitate interaction-driven, self-evolving LLM training.

stories.title: Opaque Epistemic Mediation: How LLM Deployment Configurations Shape the Validation of Pseudo-Science
stories.author: Joaquim Pina
bullet_points: Investigates the lack of stability and transparency in how major LLMs (Claude, Grok, GPT, Gemini) validate contested scientific claims.
The study specifically tests LLM responses to ethnonationalist pseudo-science across different LLM families and temporal snapshots.
Highlights the impact of deployment configurations (e.g., Grok's Fast versions) on the model's epistemic mediation and output.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release introduces performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden the range of supported models.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine, specifically improving support on Apple silicon hardware.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for advanced AI features within Claude Code.
The new capabilities include the implementation of subagents for more complex task decomposition.
Web search functionality has been added, enhancing the model's ability to access real-time information.

stories.title: Meta is royally screwing up its smart glasses rollout
stories.author: Victoria Song
bullet_points: Meta's smart glasses rollout is facing significant public backlash.
Activist groups are using guerrilla marketing tactics to criticize the device.
The criticism centers on themes of mass surveillance and privacy concerns.

stories.title: Artist sues AI meme generator for selling deeply personal comic as ad template
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: An artist is suing an AI meme generator over the unauthorized use of deeply personal comic content in its templates.
The core issue revolves around the potential for AI generators to inadvertently reuse or expose private user data through template outputs.
Experts suggest that the AI generator may have flawed template usage, highlighting risks in current generative AI systems.

stories.title: SpaceX eyes tower catch for next Starship after auspicious end to 13th flight
stories.author: Stephen Clark
bullet_points: SpaceX plans to attempt a tower catch for the next Starship flight.
This follows the successful conclusion of the 13th Starship flight.
The maneuver aims to recover the vehicle back at the launch pad.

stories.title: SM4RT: Learning Structured Motion Geometry for 4D Reconstruction
stories.author: Jiwen Lu
bullet_points: The paper addresses the challenge of extending 3D reconstruction to 4D dynamic understanding using Geometry Foundation Models (GFMs).
Existing motion perception methods often treat motion as independent point-wise displacements, which is inaccurate for real-world objects.
The proposed SM4RT method focuses on learning structured motion geometry, acknowledging that physical objects obey rigid-body kinematics.

stories.title: Explainable Reinforcement Learning for assisting Air Traffic Controllers
stories.author: Salvatore Venticinque
bullet_points: The research focuses on Explainable Reinforcement Learning (XRL) to improve AI integration in critical systems.
Building trust in AI is identified as essential for deploying AI in high-stakes environments like aviation.
The paper addresses the challenge of AI explainability as a prerequisite for seamless human-AI collaboration.

stories.title: The Regression Tax: Decomposing Why Skills Help and Hurt LLM Agents
stories.author: Baran Nama
bullet_points: The paper introduces the concept of 'Regression Tax' when adding procedural skills to LLM agents.
It highlights that standard task success metrics fail to capture the negative impact (regression) skills can have on agent performance.
The research empirically measures both skill benefits and skill-induced regressions across large-scale benchmark runs.

stories.title: Quantum Spectral Model: Data Reuploading with Input-Conditioned Frequency Support
stories.author: Casey R. Myers
bullet_points: Addresses a limitation in current Quantum Machine Learning (QML) models regarding matrix-level data representation.
Proposes a 'Quantum Spectral Model' to explicitly incorporate spectral values and subspaces for matrix-valued inputs.
Aims to align the model's inductive bias with the inherent structure of the input data, moving beyond simple coordinate-wise encoding.

stories.title: Opaque Epistemic Mediation: How LLM Deployment Configurations Shape the Validation of Pseudo-Science
stories.author: Joaquim Pina
bullet_points: The study investigates the lack of stability and transparency in how major LLMs (Claude, Grok, GPT, Gemini) validate contested scientific claims.
Researchers tested LLM responses regarding ethnonationalist pseudo-science across four different temporal snapshots (Oct 2025-Feb 2026).
The findings suggest that specific LLM deployment configurations, such as Grok's Fast versions, exhibit consistent patterns in their evaluations.

stories.title: MineValiCoder: Reliable Code Generation with Test Case Quality Mining and Bipartite Graph-Based Mutual Validation
stories.author: Bo Li
bullet_points: Introduces MineValiCoder, a new method to improve LLM-based Test-Driven Development (TDD).
Addresses the limitation of current LLM code generation systems that rely heavily on human-crafted test cases.
Mitigates issues arising from LLM stochasticity, specifically faulty or mixed-quality generated tests.

stories.title: Learning to Prepare Molecular Ground States with Transformer Models
stories.author: Enrico Rinaldi
bullet_points: The research addresses the computational bottleneck in quantum state preparation for large molecules.
It introduces ADAPT-GQE, a generative AI framework designed to synthesize efficient ground-state preparation circuits.
This work is highly relevant to advancing practical quantum advantage in quantum chemistry and materials science.

stories.title: TRACE-ROUTER: Task-Consistent and Adaptive Online Routing for Agentic AI
stories.author: Tushar Krishna
bullet_points: Introduces TRACE-ROUTER, a new routing mechanism designed for agentic AI workflows.
Addresses the limitation of existing routers that make independent, per-call decisions, which fails for long-horizon tasks.
Aims to enable task-consistent and adaptive routing by linking routing decisions to delayed, task-level outcomes.

stories.title: PinEqualizer: Full Funnel Content Exploration and Debiasing System at Pinterest
stories.author: Zhihua Zhang
bullet_points: Introduces PinEqualizer, a system designed to solve the content cold-start problem in large-scale search and recommender systems.
The solution operates across the entire multi-stage content funnel, applicable to both search and recommendation surfaces.
It effectively reduces bias that favors existing content, leading to more accurate predictions across diverse content types.

stories.title: Interpretable EEG biomarkers with bag-of-waves: Spatial and temporal waveform dictionaries for low-data regimes
stories.author: Zhandong Liu
bullet_points: Introduces 'bag-of-waves,' an interpretable framework for analyzing Electroencephalography (EEG) data.
Addresses limitations of traditional EEG analysis methods: predefined features are biased, and deep learning models lack interpretability and require large datasets.
The framework learns a small dictionary of recurring EEG waveform templates, making it suitable for low-data regimes.

stories.title: A Factorial Study of Synthetic Data Generation for Low-Resource Machine Translation using Grammar Books
stories.author: Rico Sennrich
bullet_points: Addresses the critical problem of low-resource machine translation for endangered languages lacking parallel data.
Proposes a novel pipeline using LLMs to extract linguistic knowledge (rules, examples, lexicons) from existing grammar books.
Generates synthetic parallel corpora for fine-tuning, contrasting with previous methods that used grammar content during inference.

stories.title: Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation via Byte-Prefix Marginalization
stories.author: Honggang Qi
bullet_points: The research addresses the challenge of consolidating knowledge from different language models (cross-tokenizer distillation).
Existing cross-tokenizer distillation methods often lose information or misassign probability mass from teacher models.
The proposed Byte-Prefix Marginalization (BPM) technique re-expresses the teacher's distribution to facilitate effective knowledge transfer.

stories.title: Biomedical Machine Translation for Low-Resource Arabic-Script Languages via Cross-Lingual Transfer and LoRA Adapter Merging
stories.author: Lifeng Han
bullet_points: Addresses the critical problem of low-resource biomedical Natural Language Translation (NMT) for Arabic-script languages.
Employs cross-lingual transfer, leveraging higher-resource languages (Arabic/Persian) to aid four severely low-resource targets (Dari, Pashto, Sorani Kurdish, Urdu).
Utilizes advanced fine-tuning techniques, specifically LoRA adapter merging, to improve translation quality with limited data.

stories.title: Why Large Language Models and Humans Converge and Diverge in Evaluating Creativity
stories.author: Yingyue Luna Luan
bullet_points: The study investigates the alignment between Large Language Model (LLM) evaluations of creativity and human judgments.
Evidence regarding the convergence or divergence of LLM and human creativity assessments is currently mixed.
The research examines the underlying standards used by various LLMs when evaluating creative outputs across multiple studies.

stories.title: From Isolated Tasks to Structured Capabilities: A Multilayer Taxonomy for Large Language Models
stories.author: Yanghua Xiao
bullet_points: The paper addresses the fragmentation in LLM evaluation, which currently organizes evidence by isolated tasks rather than underlying capabilities.
It introduces a novel, multi-layer taxonomy comprising 14 capability domains and 91 subskills.
This taxonomy is structured across Primitive, Constructed, and Integrative layers, guided by human cognitive science principles.

stories.title: DBA-Bench: A Production-Fidelity Benchmark for LLM-Based Database Operations Agents
stories.author: Kai Zheng
bullet_points: Introduces DBA-Bench, a new benchmark designed to evaluate LLM-based database operations agents with production-level fidelity.

Highlights four critical gaps between current LLM evaluation and real-world database operations: live-environment interaction, complexity of observation space, solution openness, and scenario completeness.
Addresses the current industry problem where inconsistent testing methodologies prevent meaningful comparison of different LLM agent approaches.

stories.title: Building AI Agents with the TypeScript Agent Development Kit (ADK)
stories.author: xbill
bullet_points: Introduces the TypeScript Agent Development Kit (ADK) for building AI agents.
Leverages Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash model for agent functionality.
Provides a deployment path using Cloud Run for practical application.
